ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   D. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Adalah, Justice 02 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam, Intoxicants 03 5.4 Israf,extravaga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
